name: FramePack
tagline: Next-frame prediction video diffusion architecture that generates long local videos on 6GB VRAM laptops.
real_test_summary: Tested progressive image-to-video generation locally on a 6GB VRAM GPU. Constant context-length packing keeps memory flat regardless of target video duration.
pros: Generates multi-second 30fps video clips within 6GB VRAM limits
Constant memory footprint prevents out-of-memory crashes on longer clips
Built-in Gradio interface previews frames progressively during generation
cons: Primarily focused on image-to-video animation rather than pure text-to-video
Requires NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support for practical generation speeds
